"''Not if you don't do what I say|Peermaid asking Leida Mothma about seeing her wedding dress early|}} This [[human]] [[Gender|female]] was a '''peermaid''' from the [[planet]] [[Chandrila]]. They were a [[peermaid]] for [[Leida Mothma]] during her [[wedding of Stekan Sculdun and Leida Mothma|wedding]] at the [[Mothma Estate]] on [[Chandrila]] in [[4 BBY]]. They had light skin, [[color|brown]] [[hair]] and blue [[eye]]s. On the first [[Standard day|day]] of the three day ceremony, Leida led them with number of other girls to see her [[Leida Mothma's wedding dress|wedding gown]]. The following day they were present for [[Perrin Fertha]]'s speech to Leida and [[Stekan Sculdun]]. During the first two days they wore a blue [[Clothing|dress]] with a gold [[belt]].{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} On the third day, they watched Leida and Stekan Sculdun marriage ceremony and later watched the couple's dance during wedding reception. During which they wore a gold shirt with a blue skirt and gold belt. Later during the reception, a [[speaker droid]] began to play music and the peermaid joined others in dancing to the music.{{Andor|Harvest}} ==Behind the scenes== The peermaid was portrayed by [[Brooke Holmewood]] in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the episode's first episode, "[[One Year Later]]," which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[April 22]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} In the episode's credits they are identified as "peermaid #1" but in the episode's subtitles they are identified as simply "Peer Maid." ==Appearances== *{{Andor|One Year Later}} {{1st|"[[Sagrona Teema]]" and "[[Harvest]]"}} *{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} *{{Andor|Harvest}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი მოახლე ქალი 1 }} [[Category:Chandrilans]] [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
